verdict.rationale: Trello documents a Power-Ups marketplace where third-party developers submit integrations and teams can find and add apps they already use. Power-Ups and integrations pull data from outside services into boards. Community users confirm building and using third-party Power-Ups (a GitLab Power-Up modeled on the GitHub one, and the NightReader plugin), but nothing documents the marketplace reaching thousands of tools, and one user reports add-on restrictions for solo users. missing for 10: evidence of marketplace scale (thousands of integrations), a catalog breadth or listing of major third-party apps, clarity on plan-based add-on limits.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: Ready to delight millions by sharing your Power-Up in the marketplace? Submit your Power-Up and get the review process started.
Find the apps your team is already using or discover new ways to get work done in Trello.
Power-Ups and integrations allow you to bring additional features to your boards and integrate your favorite apps right into Trello.
They can pull information and data from outside services directly into Trello, giving you clear perspective on your favorite tools for work.
